concepts.headline: Heel pain after 12-hour shifts?
concepts.prompt: An unedited phone photo taken from above by a nurse sitting in a hospital break room, looking down at her own feet in navy scrub pants wearing the black-purple shoe from the reference photo, on a worn linoleum floor with a chair leg and a paper cup visible, uneven overhead fluorescent light. The shoe is about 40% of the frame. A plain white headline typed on the photo at the top like a phone editing app: "HEEL PAIN AFTER 12-HOUR SHIFTS?" Three hand-drawn black marker arrows (slightly wobbly) pointing at the shoe with handwritten-style labels: "CUSHIONED HEEL", "ARCH SUPPORT", "SLIP-RESISTANT GRIP". All text is large bold, high contrast, max 5 words per label. No other text anywhere.

concepts.headline: ¿Dolor de talón después de 12 horas?
concepts.prompt: Una foto de celular sin editar tomada desde arriba por una enfermera sentada en la sala de descanso de un hospital, mirando sus propios pies en pantalón de uniforme azul marino con el zapato negro-morado del referente, sobre un piso de linóleo gastado con la pata de una silla y un vaso de papel a la vista, luz fluorescente pareja. El zapato ocupa ~40% del cuadro. Un titular blanco simple escrito sobre la foto como en una app de edición del celular arriba: "¿DOLOR DE TALÓN DESPUÉS DE 12 HORAS?" Tres flechas dibujadas a mano con marcador negro (algo chuecas) apuntan al zapato con etiquetas estilo manuscrito: "TALÓN ACOLCHADO", "SOPORTE DE ARCO", "SUELA ANTIDERRAPANTE". Todo el texto es grande y en negrita, de alto contraste, máximo 5 palabras por etiqueta. Ningún otro texto.

concepts.headline: Nurses: feet hurt by hour 8?
concepts.prompt: An unedited phone photo of the inside of a hospital staff locker: the navy shoe from the reference photo sitting on the locker shelf next to a lanyard and a stethoscope, about 35% of the frame, uneven light. Three small yellow sticky notes handwritten in black marker stuck on the locker door: "ARCH SUPPORT", "CUSHIONED HEEL", "WIDE TOE BOX". Plain white typed headline at the top like a phone editing app: "NURSES: FEET HURT BY HOUR 8?" In the bottom-right corner one small white handwritten-style sticky note, smaller than the others, with three tiny lines: "40% OFF", "30-DAY MONEY-BACK GUARANTEE", "FREE SHIPPING". All text is large bold, high contrast, max 5 words per label. No other text anywhere.

Todo el texto es grande y en negrita, de alto contraste, máximo 5 palabras por etiqueta. Ningún otro texto.

concepts.headline: Nurses: tired feet after 12 hours?
concepts.prompt: An unedited phone photo from above of a made bed with a grey blanket: two pairs of the all-black shoe from the reference photo side by side at true proportions (about 40% of the frame), a 3-pack of black cushioned socks in a plain paper band and a plain navy duffel travel bag next to them, no brand logos. Plain white typed headline at the top like a phone editing app: "NURSES: TIRED FEET AFTER 12 HOURS?" Two handwritten-style labels with thin arrows on the shoes: "ARCH SUPPORT", "CUSHIONED HEEL". In the bottom-left corner one small handwritten note card, smaller than the headline, reading: "BLACK FRIDAY: BUY 2 PAIRS, GET 2 FREE GIFTS" and two tiny handwritten tags pointing to the socks and the bag: "3-PACK CUSHIONED SOCKS", "FREE TRAVEL BAG". No other offer text. All text is large bold, high contrast, max 5 words per label. No other text anywhere.
